case.query: I have two separate questions: Besides personal care like bathing, what other types of household tasks can home care services help me with? I was told I have carotid artery disease. What is the main reason these arteries in my neck become narrow or blocked?
evidence: Home care services include: Personal care, such as help with bathing, washing your hair, or getting dressed Household chores, such as cleaning, yard work, and laundry Cooking for you in your home or delivering meals to you Money management, such as help filling out forms and making sure that your bills are paid on time Health care, such as having a home health aide come to your home or getting care from your provider through telehealth You can get almost any type of help you want in your home.
If you have carotid artery disease, the arteries become narrow or blocked, usually because of atherosclerosis .
